map_role: Asymmetric freight transfer between a harbour settlement and distant rail/customs settlement across a nested dry ravine
macro_topology: Braided upper and lower cross-rift bridges, isolated middle island, two asymmetrically developed settlements, and a connected deep recovery gallery
density_profile: Dense west ship-and-counterweight, deliberately open suspended ravine, dense east rail-classification and inspection, thin underworks

route_grammar.main: West mooring → mid-height open-air service ribbon → East dispatch
route_grammar.braided: High bridge and broken lower service spur produce genuine different interwoven routes
route_grammar.lower: Deep recovery gallery with vertical return shafts and optional edit niches
route_grammar.detour: Source-grid solid obstruction on approach produces real path-length increase with all sites retained

strong_motifs: tapered drylocked cargo freighter with entered hull
stepped eastern classifier and inspection towers
interesting_relationships: The high viaduct is mostly suspended over a vast editable gorge void
The missing lower span is visible directly below the serviceable high bridge
Eastern dispatch levels descend while western dock/hoist rises
Deep maintenance passages pass under disconnected topographical districts, returning through multiple shafts
authoring_affordances: Open cross-rift space reserved for later SWARM/GENTEK bridge modules
Broken lower-service-bridge seam suitable for human extension or collapse event
Sparse middle-island interior for procedural machinery
Lightly provisioned recovery niches deliberately left editable

setpiece_candidates.name: Lower-bridge severance
setpiece_candidates.geometry: Unconnected rail ends with another reachable route overhead; no scripted collapse

setpiece_candidates.name: Counterweight actuator
setpiece_candidates.geometry: Visible inert paired drum at an entered maintenance aperture

setpiece_candidates.name: Gorge island
setpiece_candidates.geometry: Central nested partly excavated basalt mass with deep return

setpiece_candidates.name: Customs dispatch
setpiece_candidates.geometry: Rail-to-measuring-platform handoff in the east terminal

procedural_exemplar_value: Braided independent freight route alternatives versus one straight arch
Deliberately severed yet safely bypassable lower bridge
Three vertically overlapping route layers with actual free-hull portals
Large negative-space allocation adjacent to compact functional districts
similarity_avoidance: Unlike Orison's single central ring, Nacre's stacklift or Calder's stepped continuous inclines, this design uses a separated basalt island and two nonparallel bridges, with an unfinished lower span and wide largely unbuilt central basin.

material_contract.native_behavior: static inert solids; no mobile fluids
